metaTitle: Custom Adjustable Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom adjustable badge ID holders for your team. Perfect for trade shows and daily use. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Adjustable badge ID holders give your team the flexibility to wear credentials at different lengths, whether over a shirt pocket or around the neck. Choose from retractable reels, lanyard clips, or sliding strap designs that accommodate various badge sizes. Ideal for trade shows, security teams, and daily office use, these holders keep IDs visible and secure while allowing quick scanning. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a professional look that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom adjustable badge ID holders with retractable reel and logo imprint, displayed on a lanyard
